selected_branch: Measured crossing-entry timing at median opening with inoperative-signal qualification.
binding_note: Frozen witness moves inoperative-signal branch from other_vehicle C125714 into same-layout C125697.

cases.purpose: Inoperative-signal median crossing; ego spatially left, both complete bodies enter close in measured time
cases.physical_risk: vehicle timing drifts or routes fail to share one crossing

cases.purpose: Same crossing and timing with ego spatially right
cases.physical_risk: approach orientation may change other fixed conditions

cases.purpose: Same ego-left geometry with clearly separated measured entries
cases.physical_risk: traffic or braking can compress intended separation

cases.purpose: Opposite approaches, one intending or making left turn for statutory exception context
cases.physical_risk: median route may not support opposite-turn trajectory

cases.purpose: Same junction with operative governing traffic signal for official-device exclusion
cases.physical_risk: signal phase may change at entry

fixed_conditions: same statutory median crossing, two highways, measured entry timing and original-frame cameras
deliberate_differences: which subject approach is spatially left/right

fixed_conditions: same crossing, approach geometry, signal and actor class
deliberate_differences: measured entry-time difference; no legal numeric cutoff

fixed_conditions: same installed heads, crossing and routes
deliberate_differences: inoperative versus operative signal state at entry

fixed_conditions: same selected crossing polygon, actor class, Off entrance-head control, complete-body entry method and four original source cameras
deliberate_differences: perpendicular different-highway approaches versus opposite directions on one highway
other vehicle follows an authored westbound-to-southbound left turn
comparisons.interpretation_limit: The opposite case probes the statutory exclusion context; same-highway identities do not establish the separate different-highways premise or a legal conclusion.

evidence_review.uncovered: All exact cases; evidence.json has zero accepted recordings.

observations: source-backed same statutory crossing through median opening and two different highways
complete original-frame body entry times and approach bearings/right-side geometry
all entrance signal head identities, installed/uncovered status and Off state at entry
opposite-direction left-turn intention/action and yielding context
runtime_uncertainties: A map median opening alone does not prove one statutory roadway crossing; source review must address separate intersections and spacing.
Native Off is an engineering state and does not decide legal subsection-4 qualification.
Approximately same time is judgmental; no legal numeric window is invented.
planning_status: partial; five selected constructions and fifteen fallbacks have source-bound exact CPU offline/compatibility/saved proofs; comparison and delivery audits pass, real site and semantic stage chain remain open
